verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's automations documentation says scheduled tasks can start automatically when a supported Gmail, Slack, or GitHub event occurs. Examples include triaging new email, summarizing channel activity, and acting on pull request feedback without polling. This is first-party event-triggered automation, though the sources are limited and the rule-definition depth is not described. Missing for 10: documentation of rule conditions or filters, supported event sources beyond Gmail, Slack and GitHub, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Scheduled tasks can now start when a supported event occurs in Gmail, Slack, or GitHub.
Use an event trigger to triage new email, summarize channel activity, or act on pull request feedback without polling on a fixed cadence.
